home.motto: Constantly responding, constantly still, always pure and still.
home.mottoEn: Constantly responding, constantly still, always pure and still.
home.contactBody: If you'd like to talk about collaboration, projects, or just say hello, I'll reply thoughtfully.
home.introBody: I'm a full-stack developer specializing in building web applications with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. With 3 years of web application development experience and full-stack capabilities, I've led small teams in delivering AI-integrated B2B SaaS products and am passionate about real-time systems and scalable architecture design. In my spare time, I enjoy exploring obscure knowledge, listening to music, and tinkering with new technologies.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: I build product-facing web applications with a focus on delivery, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

intro.title: How I work?
intro.paragraph1: I start by clarifying goals and constraints, then break work into deliverable iterations. During implementation, I prioritize readability, clear boundaries, and testability to keep systems maintainable.
intro.paragraph2: For release quality, I focus on performance baselines, error visibility, and regression control so production behavior stays predictable and issues are easy to trace.

focus.frontend: Crafting fast, responsive, easy-to-understand frontend experiences
focus.fullstack: Connecting frontend experience with backend reliability
focus.product: Balancing engineering quality with delivery speed

me.title: Who Am I?
me.content: I am a frontend-leaning full-stack engineer with around three years of development experience. I mainly work with React, TypeScript, C#, and modern web stacks, with a steady focus on interaction quality, performance, and maintainability.

background.title: About My Background
background.content: I did not come from a traditional computer science background. At 18, while still figuring out direction, I chose to study mathematics at New York University. That training gave me strong logical decomposition skills, and it still shapes the way I think about abstraction and system design in software engineering.

blog.title: About My Blog
blog.content: I use this space to share technical articles, project reflections, and observations from daily life. If something resonates with you, feel free to leave a comment.

values.title: Working Principles
values.ownership: Own outcomes: delivery includes monitoring, fixes, and continuous improvement.
values.consistency: Keep consistency: shared naming and structure reduce team friction and maintenance cost.
values.learning: Iterate deliberately: each release should produce reusable lessons for the next cycle.

next.title: Keep Exploring
next.description: If you'd like a broader sense of how I think and build, continue with my projects and blog.

cv.summary: Frontend Engineer (React/Next.js) with 3 years of building web apps and full-stack proficiency. Proven leader in AI-integrated B2B SaaS. Passionate about real-time systems and scalable architecture.

highlights: Led team in code reviews, reducing production bugs by 30% and accelerating feature delivery.
Engineered a real-time AI data pipeline with OpenAI API + FastAPI + SSE, cutting UI latency by 40% and boosting user engagement.
Optimized data handling, saving 25% in API costs.
Eliminated auth bottlenecks through custom Auth0.js integration supporting SSR/CSR.

education.degree: Bachelor of Arts in Mathematics and Economics, Minor in Japanese

projects.name: Moments
highlights: Designed a notification system for friend requests and comments, solved the N+1 problem.
Reduced auth setup time by 80% with NextAuth.js (Google/GitHub OAuth).

projects.name: Discord Clone
highlights: Cut state-related bugs by 40% and improved code maintainability after refactoring with Redux.
Designed user preference system using local storage, improving session persistence by 90%.
Implemented 50ms-latency voice/video using Agora Web SDK.

projects.name: Tripadvisor Clone
highlights: Slashed Google Maps API calls by 90% via debounce + Search This Area optimization.
Integrated real-time weather data, boosting user session time by 25%.

projects.name: LaoMa Spicy
highlights: Accelerated landing page load time by 10% (3.2s → 2.9s) using Canvas video rendering.
Increased mobile conversions by 15% with gesture-friendly cart design.

help.title: Support Resources
help.subtitle: Choose the support path that fits your problem best. For bugs, the fastest route is usually a reproducible GitHub issue.

email.title: Send Me an Email
email.description: Best for account issues, broken flows, or anything you want to explain in detail.
points: Describe what you expected to happen.
Include screenshots or console errors if possible.

issue.title: Submit an Issue
issue.description: Use GitHub Issues when you find a bug, regression, or anything reproducible.
points: List the exact steps to reproduce it.
Paste the error message if one appears.

feature.title: Request a Feature
feature.description: If you have an idea that would make the site better, send a feature request instead of a bug report.
points: Explain the problem you are trying to solve.
Add references or examples if you have them.

browse.title: Check Existing Reports
browse.description: Before opening a new ticket, check current issues to see whether the problem is already tracked.
points: Search by page name, feature, or error text.
Add context to an existing issue if it matches.

help.footer: Clear reports get fixed faster and make follow-up much easier.
